title: Concerto
identity: The assignment identifies Harold Farberman’s Concerto, General Music Publishing catalog GEN823, for alto saxophone with piano reduction/orchestra. A copyright index lists an alto-saxophone-and-strings concerto with piano reduction by Farberman in an 1984 copyright record, but the relationship to GEN823 and its current edition was not confirmed.

evidence.claim: Copyright record indexes Farberman’s Concerto for alto saxophone and strings, including piano reduction, as an 1984 recordation. It does not identify the General GEN823 edition.
evidence.source_name: Copyright Encyclopedia index of U.S. copyright catalog

evidence.claim: The existing work listing names General Music Publishing GEN823.

review_focus: First confirm that GEN823 is the same work/version as the indexed alto-and-strings concerto; then review solo writing against piano reduction.
collection_flag: Orchestral concerto with piano reduction according to secondary catalog/copyright metadata; no further college-program or pedagogical evidence located.
gaps: No score, recording, movement structure or duration verified.
